## The word, and what the tool says

```text
$ etimo <word>
```

## What the entry says

<!-- The wikitext, or the sentence that matters. This is the ground truth:
     etimo does not judge Wiktionary. If the entry is wrong, etimo is right to
     report it wrong. The defect is only ever an infidelity to what is written. -->

## Which kind

- [ ] **Invents an ancestor** the source did not claim — the grave kind
- [ ] **Loses a link** the source stated — the venial kind
- [ ] Presents a limit of the tool as a fact about the language

## How often

<!-- One entry or a class? If a class, measure it before proposing a fix: a
     table widened for a single case has widened for every case. -->
